title: Domain Pack Manifest
$comment: V2 Phase 1B (BL-018, docs/v2/10-BACKLOG.md). Validates the manifest shape defined in docs/v2/04-DOMAIN-PACK-SPEC.md. Deliberately domain-agnostic -- must validate the Berries pack (domain-packs/berries/) and an unrelated industry pack equally well, per that spec's own 'second-domain check' discipline (D-007, docs/v2/08-DECISION-LOG.md). Contains no berry-specific (or any other domain's) entity types, predicates, taxonomy values, or labels -- those live only in the pack's own data files, referenced here by path. Phase 1 requires only the six contribution surfaces docs/v2/07-IMPLEMENTATION-ROADMAP.md's Phase 1 scope names (entity types, relationship predicates, taxonomies, strategic-question templates, collector templates, plus this manifest itself); report templates, filters, and visualization configuration remain optional/unrequired here until a concrete need is demonstrated (Phase 1.5/Phase 4).

id.$comment: The Domain Pack's own id, e.g. 'berries' -- not an entity id, not scoped by the core id patterns used elsewhere (ev-, fact-, etc.).

version.$comment: Semver, independent of the core platform version (docs/v2/04-DOMAIN-PACK-SPEC.md, 'Versioning').

domain_scope.$comment: Generic scope tags this pack narrows to (e.g. berry ids for the Berries pack, product categories for a different pack). Not interpreted by this schema -- meaning is entirely pack-defined.

notes.$comment: Free-text space for a pack author to record known gaps, unresolved taxonomy questions, or scope decisions -- mirrors the precedent set by data/imports/blueberry-public-pilot-2026-08-03/manifest.json's own 'notes' field.

report_templates_dir.$comment: Optional, not required in Phase 1 (docs/v2/07-IMPLEMENTATION-ROADMAP.md Phase 1 scope note) -- Section 6 of docs/v2/04-DOMAIN-PACK-SPEC.md remains specified for later use.

filters_file.$comment: Optional, not required in Phase 1 -- Section 7 of docs/v2/04-DOMAIN-PACK-SPEC.md.

visualization_config_file.$comment: Optional, not required in Phase 1 -- Section 8 of docs/v2/04-DOMAIN-PACK-SPEC.md.
